remarks: SPECTACULAR ELEVATED LOCATION, BREATHTAKING VIEWS, AND EXCEPTIONAL POTENTIAL TO GROW! Perched at the highest elevation in the prestigious gated Kensington enclave of Aliso Viejo, 16 Groveside combines timeless elegance, versatility, and sweeping panoramic views of Saddleback Mountain, surrounding valleys, and sparkling city lights. Built by Richmond American Homes, this beautifully appointed residence features 3 spacious bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and a flexible, expansive floor plan. Inside, soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and elegant rich hardwood flooring create an atmosphere of warmth and sophistication.
